source_text: Caveat: Baehrens notat plerasque HSS Librum Quartum a Tertio non distinguere; editio [LIBER QUARTUS] ad Surge, veni inserit. Lectorem moneamus nuptialia verba spiritaliter de Verbo et anima sive Christo et ecclesia intellegenda, ne littera scandalum faciat.
pass_a_gloss: Caveat: Baehrens notes most manuscripts Book Fourth from Third not to-distinguish; edition [BOOK FOURTH] at Rise, come inserts. Reader let-us-warn nuptial words spiritually concerning Word and soul or Christ and church to-be-understood, lest letter scandal may-make.
pass_b_english: Caveat: Baehrens notes that most manuscripts do not separate the Fourth Book from the Third; the edition inserts [LIBER QUARTUS] at Arise, come. Let us warn the reader that the nuptial words are to be understood spiritually of the Word and the soul, or of Christ and the church, lest the letter cause scandal.
notes: Baehrens apparatus: Trennung oft nicht durchgeführt.
